integrity: Analytical proof of infinite nonconvergence with explicit coefficient weights and reproducible exact finite binomial checks. Known divergent weighted-shift mechanism credited to Cho, Jung and Lee (2005).
scientific_limitations: A counterexample for an explicitly specified weighted Hardy space and the monomial symbol z squared; it does not cover the two linear-fractional symbols in Question 5.1 or the classical unweighted Hardy space.
title: A bounded monomial composition operator with nonconvergent Aluthge iterates
